en-US.title: FlyRight: Flight Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Travel buddy & delay claims
en-US.description:
FlyRight is the app you open on the day you fly — and the one that stands up for you when the flight goes wrong.

TRAVEL DAY, LIVE
Add a flight with just the flight number, scan your boarding pass, or share the airline's confirmation PDF and every leg imports on its own. From then on FlyRight follows the day for you: check-in opens, gate assigned, boarding, pushback, layover time, landing. A Live Activity keeps the countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, so you never open the app just to check.

PEOPLE WHO FLY WITH YOU
Follow friends and family and see their travel day live — no more "did you land?" texts. You choose who sees each trip: everyone following you, your close circle, or only you.

YOUR TRAVEL JOURNAL
Every flight becomes a page: notes, a rating, seat and booking reference, photos. Share a moment from inside a trip with the people following you.

THE WORLD YOU'VE FLOWN
A map of every route, kilometres flown, records and places — with a poster you can share.

WHEN THE FLIGHT GOES WRONG
Because FlyRight is already tracking your flight, you know the moment a delay or cancellation qualifies under EU261 — and how much: up to €600 per passenger. A clear verdict, a ready-to-send claim, and deadline reminders so you never miss a claim window.

WHAT YOU GET
• Live flight status with gate, delay and layover tracking
• Lock Screen Live Activity with the countdown to your next step
• Boarding-pass scanner and airline PDF import
• Follow people and share your travel day
• Trip journal with photos and notes
• World map, travel stats and shareable posters
• Instant EU261 compensation verdicts and claim guidance
• No account needed — sign in only to keep your travels across devices

Owed Pro adds compensation claims, early warning when your inbound aircraft is running late, and room for more people to follow you. Everything else is free.

Privacy policy: https://getflyright.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://getflyright.com/terms
en-US.releaseNotes:
The biggest FlyRight update yet:

• Scan your boarding pass — point the camera at any pass and the flight is added instantly.
• World map — every journey you've flown, drawn as flight routes on a zoomable globe-style map.
• Earlier delay warnings — FlyRight watches your aircraft's inbound rotation and can flag a likely delay before departure.
• Apple Watch — your travel day now appears in the Smart Stack on your wrist.
• Redesigned Add flight with a proper calendar and boarding-pass styling.
• Claim tracking — record airline replies (acknowledged, paid, rejected) and re-read the exact claim email you sent.
• Save past flights straight to My travels, smarter airport search, side-by-side layout on iPad, and lots of polish and fixes.
en-US.promotionalText: Your travel buddy on the day you fly. Live flight tracking, people who follow your trip, a journal, and what you are owed when it goes wrong.

review.notes:
FlyRight 1.0.18 — feature update (new: boarding-pass scanner, World map tab, inbound-aircraft delay prediction, Apple Watch Smart Stack support, redesigned Add flight, claim outcome tracking).

DEMO ACCOUNT — HOW TO SIGN IN: Settings tab -> 'Sign in or create account' -> enter the email above -> tap Continue -> tap 'Use another method' -> 'Sign in with your password' -> enter the password. No email code is needed for this account. (The demo password is maintained directly in App Store Connect, not in this file.)

This account's FlyRight Pro subscription (promotional, yearly entitlement) has already EXPIRED, so the expired-subscription purchase flow is reviewable: Settings -> 'Get FlyRight Pro' shows the paywall again, and Restore purchases finds no active purchase. New purchases can be tested with the App Store sandbox as usual.

Notes:
- The app is fully usable without sign-in; purchases are device/receipt based (RevenueCat). The account only backs up travel history and links web purchases.
- The boarding-pass scanner requires the camera; any airline boarding pass (paper or screen) with a PDF417/Aztec barcode works. Flights can always be added manually with just a flight number.
- The camera/location usage strings are declared; the app never requests location (a bundled notification SDK references the API, hence the notice).
